caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a long-handled tool with a loop at one end and a clamp or gripping mechanism at the other. The tool is illustrated with shades of brown, green, and hints of red or rust, suggesting a metallic and possibly aged surface. The shaft of the tool is straight and slender, with the lower end forming a closed circular loop. The opposite (upper) end features a more complex structure: a curved clamp or pincer, with a partial hoop and a perpendicular flat edge. To the lower right of the shaft, there is a large, red numeral "2" outlined in black. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist's signature, "Elizabeth Chambers," written in small cursive text near the bottom right corner. The corners of the image show slight discoloration or wear.
title: Branding Iron
